title: Chidi and the Bachelor Pad Swamp

scenes.picture: Chidi sitting on a grey fabric sofa, eating a large plate of oily Jollof rice. A huge glob of red oil drops onto the sofa cushion.
scenes.dialogue: Chai! This Jollof sweet but the oil don land for my only sofa! Make I quickly wipe am.
scenes.caption: When enjoyment turn to emergency.

scenes.picture: Chidi is vigorously scrubbing the sofa with a giant green sponge and a bucket full of soapy bubbles. The soap suds are everywhere.
scenes.dialogue: No shaking, small soap and power go fix this one sharp-sharp.
scenes.caption: Chidi think say na jeans he dey wash.

scenes.picture: Aunty Ngozi enters the room, holding a bottle of bleach and a kettle of boiling water. Chidi looks hopeful.
scenes.dialogue: Chidi my pikin, comot for there! Use bleach and hot water, the stain go disappear one time!
scenes.caption: Aunty Ngozi and her 'I get experience' advice.

scenes.picture: The sofa now has a giant, ugly yellow-white patch where the bleach burnt the fabric. Chidi is holding his head in his hands.
scenes.dialogue: Aunty! The stain don go but the sofa don get tribal mark! How I go explain this one?
scenes.caption: From oil stain to permanent designer map.

scenes.picture: Chidi is using a hair dryer and a big standing fan to dry the soaking wet, discoloured sofa. The room looks humid and messy.
scenes.dialogue: The place come dey smell like wet dog. My date dey come by 6pm o!
scenes.caption: Bachelor pad don turn to local car wash.

scenes.picture: A Neat Naija attendant in a sharp green uniform and glasses is using a professional vacuum extractor on the sofa. Chidi is smiling, looking relieved.
scenes.dialogue: Oga Chidi, no worry. We go fix the mess and the scent. Your chair go fresh like today you buy am.
scenes.caption: Stop the stress, use professionals. Laundry, house, office, sofa and carpet cleaning. DM to book.
